harness: Future authorized disposable PostgreSQL, deterministic injected DB clock through a test-only clock boundary, two independent connections/worker processes with barriers, explicit crash points and synthetic provider transport. No real provider or production DB required for deterministic cases. Test fixtures never replace actual release authority.
universal_assertions: No dispatch before admission and marker commit
Day and campaign balances conserve and remain nonnegative
At most two occupied or suspect slots
At most two marked provider ordinals per run
No raw IP, read capability, key or secret in logs

cases.setup: Same key, bucket and payload; first admission committed
cases.expect: 202 same run receipt; one rate event, reserve and outbox; no token reissue

cases.setup: Existing key
cases.action: Change payload digest under same bucket
cases.expect: 409; all balances/counters unchanged

cases.setup: Existing key
cases.action: Repeat at +600s and campaign+1 day; run cleanup job
cases.expect: 410; tombstone retained through end+30d or unresolved liability; no fresh admission

cases.setup: Two DB connections paused before control lock, same key
cases.expect: One 201 and one 202; one run/reserve/outbox; provider ordinal unique

cases.setup: Three prior admitted starts within rolling hour; completed slots
cases.expect: 429 then eligible subject to other caps; rejected event not counted

cases.setup: Ten same-client starts spread over UTC day, hour capacity available
cases.expect: 429 CLIENT_RATE_LIMIT; no reserve

cases.setup: Twenty global starts across clients, reserve capacity otherwise sufficient
cases.expect: 429 GLOBAL_DAY_LIMIT; no side effects

cases.setup: Two occupied slots
cases.action: Third admission, then expire one heartbeat
cases.expect: 503 both times; expired slot SUSPECT, not free

cases.setup: Exactly 200000 available in day and campaign; slots free; rates available
cases.action: Two workers reserve concurrently with distinct keys
cases.expect: One admitted; one budget denial; never negative or double reserve

cases.setup: Crash at each write in uncommitted admission transaction
cases.expect: Rollback all partial rows; one eventual admission; zero precommit sends

cases.setup: Admission committed, no marker; crash worker
cases.action: Recover same outbox before deadline with no-send proof
cases.expect: One owner binding and execution; no new rate or reserve

cases.setup: Crash just after dispatch marker commit before send
cases.expect: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; ordinal not resent; committed maximum retained

cases.setup: Provider accepted request but response lost
cases.expect: No automatic second paid call; slot quarantined until closure proof; conservative charge

cases.setup: Known closed run ready to settle
cases.action: Two workers settle concurrently; replay settlement
cases.expect: One SETTLE event; both ledgers change once; identical repeats no-op; conflicting settlement rejected

cases.setup: Run admitted 23:59:59 UTC
cases.action: Dispatch/settle next day; admit new run next day
cases.expect: Old reserve/cost belongs to old admission day; new day counters independent; campaign continuous

cases.setup: Campaign available 199999; fresh day full
cases.action: Admit with exhausted campaign; separately use available budget just before, exactly at and after 2026-10-17T15:00:00Z (2026-10-18T00:00:00+09:00 exclusive)
cases.expect: Exhaustion denies across month rollover; before cutoff eligible subject to caps; at/after cutoff no new admission. UTC daily accounting remains unchanged.

cases.setup: Untrusted socket peer or trusted peer with comma XFF, Forwarded or conflicting X-Real-IP
cases.expect: 503 IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE or bounded invalid-request denial; no client authority or admission

cases.setup: Equivalent compressed/expanded IPv6 in same /64 and IPv4-mapped IPv6
cases.expect: Same /64 shares bucket; mapped IPv4 equals native /32; zone IDs and ports rejected

cases.setup: Missing trusted edge allowlist or missing overwrite proof/header
cases.expect: Fail closed; browser-generated client ID never substitutes

cases.setup: Two runs with independent capabilities
cases.action: Read run B with token A, then ID only, expired token and unknown ID
cases.expect: Uniform 404; no cross-run status disclosure

cases.setup: Valid request with wrong, null, duplicate or absent Origin
cases.expect: 403; no CORS reflection; no side effects

cases.setup: Exact allowed Origin and preflight header subset
cases.expect: 204 preflight without admission; exact ACAO, no credentials/wildcard, Vary Origin and no-store

cases.setup: DB fails before transaction or commit acknowledgement lost
cases.action: Client retries same key after recovery
cases.expect: No premature dispatch; resolve committed identity or admit once if rollback; no fresh-key retry

cases.setup: Live DB/provider unavailable, budgets exhausted
cases.expect: Replay unchanged and available; no Live failure relabeled ACCEPTED Replay

cases.setup: Paused old dispatcher with committed marker, lease expires and generation advances
cases.action: Attempt slot reclaim then resume old worker
cases.expect: No slot reuse without termination proof; at most two possible active effects

cases.setup: Two known failed/finished provider calls
cases.action: Request third ordinal or retry under new ordinal
cases.expect: Denied; total paid calls includes retry and stays <=2

cases.setup: Missing usage then late lower usage; separate above-bound usage case
cases.expect: Charge maximum once; late evidence appended without refund; above bound closes admission gate and preserves actual evidence

cases.setup: Invalid UTF8, duplicate JSON keys, extra fields, >1024 bytes, multipart/upload, query and cancel route
cases.expect: Exact 400/413/415/404 contract; no provider or admission

cases.setup: Initial successful 201 never received after admission commit
cases.action: Retry same key within replay window
cases.expect: 202 receipt no capability; no recovery via IP/key; no automatic replacement run. This is not ordinary refresh after received 201.

cases.setup: Shared NAT clients and changed browser IDs; HMAC emergency rotation
cases.expect: Same IP bucket shares limits; browser ID ignored; rotation pauses rather than resets counters

cases.setup: Runtime DB role
cases.action: Attempt direct DML, delete money journal or third slot, bypass control lock function
cases.expect: Permissions/constraints deny; owner DB credentials unavailable

cases.setup: Provider success without admitted evidence/Judgment
cases.action: Read status and attempt terminal projection
cases.expect: GOVERNANCE_PENDING; cannot report workflow ACCEPTED from provider result alone

cases.setup: Valid read token, 30 reads within minute; malformed-token flood
cases.expect: 429 for authorized read limit; shared ingress bounds unauthenticated traffic; no paid effects

cases.setup: DB time moves backwards after control lock timestamp
cases.expect: Gate fails closed; no rate-window reset

cases.setup: Successful 201 received and capability written to same-tab sessionStorage
cases.action: Refresh same tab then GET with retained capability; compare independent new tab/session without capability and tab/session close
cases.expect: Same-tab refresh GET succeeds until 24h expiry; independent tab/session cannot recover and GET without capability returns 404; close loses token; no URL/cookie/localStorage persistence or capability logging

release_only_evidence: Actual Railway trusted peer/header overwrite/spoof verification
Actual supervisor and isolated tool/network/filesystem boundary
Separately authorized provider profile and cost envelope proof
Human integrated release acceptance; H1-H7 design choices already accepted
non_substitution: Designed cases are not executed tests; deterministic transport is not actual provider or deployed security proof.
